subject: general
question:
​Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and W live on different floors in a building having seven floors (first floor is the lowermost floor, then second floor is above it and then so on). Only one person lives on one floor. P lives on one of the floor above S and S does not live on an odd numbered floor. Only two persons live between S and T. U lives immediately above W. Only four persons live between T and P.

Who are the neighbours of P?
solution:
**Persons :** P, Q, R, S, T, U and W

**Floors : **1 (lowermost floor) to 7 (topmost floor)

1) Only two persons live between S and T and only four persons live between T and P.

2) P lives on one of the floor above S and S does not live on an odd numbered floor. (So, case 1 is eliminated)

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
